items.text: Kansas City (early week, Tue): DNP - RT Jaylon Moore (ankle). LIMITED - RB Kenneth Walker III (groin, first practice since Wk10), DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee). FULL - RG Trey Smith (concussion, set to return), TE Noah Gray (rib). New IR - FB Ben VanSumeren. Mahomes not on report.

Buffalo (early week, Mon estimate): DNP - CB Christian Benford (groin, missed last game). LIMITED - TE Dalton Kincaid, DE Greg Rousseau, RT Spencer Brown (back), S Damar Hamlin, DL T.J. Sanders, RG O'Cyrus Torrance (ankle), LB Dorian Williams. IR - WR Joshua Palmer. Josh Allen not on report.
